name: Claude Certified Architect – Foundations
itemFormat: Multiple-choice and multiple-response items; each item states how many responses to select
examStructure: 4 scenarios drawn at random from a bank of 6 for each exam session
intendedAudience: Solution architects with 6+ months practical experience building with Claude APIs, Agent SDK, Claude Code, and MCP in production environments.

taskStatements.statement: Design and implement agentic loops for autonomous task execution
taskStatements.summary: stop_reason-driven loop control (tool_use vs end_turn), appending tool results to context, avoiding anti-patterns like parsing NL for termination or arbitrary iteration caps.

taskStatements.statement: Orchestrate multi-agent systems with coordinator-subagent patterns
taskStatements.summary: Hub-and-spoke architecture, isolated subagent context, dynamic subagent selection, iterative refinement loops, routing communication through the coordinator.

taskStatements.statement: Configure subagent invocation, context passing, and spawning
taskStatements.summary: Task tool + allowedTools, explicit context passing (no auto-inheritance), AgentDefinition config, fork-based sessions, parallel Task calls in a single response.

taskStatements.statement: Implement multi-step workflows with enforcement and handoff patterns
taskStatements.summary: Programmatic enforcement (hooks/prerequisite gates) vs prompt-based guidance; structured handoff summaries for human escalation.

taskStatements.statement: Apply Agent SDK hooks for tool call interception and data normalization
taskStatements.summary: PostToolUse hooks for normalization, tool-call interception hooks for policy enforcement, hooks vs prompt-based compliance.

taskStatements.statement: Design task decomposition strategies for complex workflows
taskStatements.summary: Fixed prompt chaining vs dynamic adaptive decomposition; per-file + cross-file review passes; adaptive investigation plans.

taskStatements.statement: Manage session state, resumption, and forking
taskStatements.summary: --resume <session-name>, fork_session for divergent exploration, informing resumed sessions of file changes, fresh session + injected summary vs stale resumption.

taskStatements.statement: Design effective tool interfaces with clear descriptions and boundaries
taskStatements.summary: Tool descriptions as the primary LLM tool-selection mechanism; avoiding ambiguous/overlapping descriptions; splitting generic tools into purpose-specific ones.

taskStatements.statement: Implement structured error responses for MCP tools
taskStatements.summary: MCP isError flag; transient/validation/business/permission error categories; isRetryable metadata; local recovery vs propagation.

taskStatements.statement: Distribute tools appropriately across agents and configure tool choice
taskStatements.summary: Too many tools degrades selection reliability; scoped tool access per role; tool_choice: auto/any/forced.

taskStatements.statement: Integrate MCP servers into Claude Code and agent workflows
taskStatements.summary: Project-scoped .mcp.json vs user-scoped ~/.claude.json; env var expansion for secrets; MCP resources for content catalogs.

taskStatements.statement: Select and apply built-in tools (Read, Write, Edit, Bash, Grep, Glob) effectively
taskStatements.summary: Grep for content search, Glob for path patterns, Read+Write fallback when Edit's unique-match fails, incremental codebase exploration.

taskStatements.statement: Configure CLAUDE.md files with appropriate hierarchy, scoping, and modular organization
taskStatements.summary: User/project/directory hierarchy, @import syntax, .claude/rules/ as alternative to monolithic CLAUDE.md, /memory command for diagnosis.

taskStatements.statement: Create and configure custom slash commands and skills
taskStatements.summary: Project-scoped .claude/commands/ vs user-scoped ~/.claude/commands/; SKILL.md frontmatter (context: fork, allowed-tools, argument-hint); personal skill variants.

taskStatements.statement: Apply path-specific rules for conditional convention loading
taskStatements.summary: .claude/rules/ YAML frontmatter with glob 'paths' fields; loading only for matching files; advantage over directory-level CLAUDE.md for scattered file types.

taskStatements.statement: Determine when to use plan mode vs direct execution
taskStatements.summary: Plan mode for architectural/multi-file complexity; direct execution for well-scoped single-file changes; Explore subagent for verbose discovery.

taskStatements.statement: Apply iterative refinement techniques for progressive improvement
taskStatements.summary: Concrete input/output examples, test-driven iteration, the interview pattern, batching interacting fixes vs sequential independent fixes.

taskStatements.statement: Integrate Claude Code into CI/CD pipelines
taskStatements.summary: -p/--print for non-interactive mode, --output-format json + --json-schema, CLAUDE.md for CI context, independent review sessions vs self-review.

taskStatements.statement: Design prompts with explicit criteria to improve precision and reduce false positives
taskStatements.summary: Explicit categorical criteria beats vague 'be conservative' instructions; false-positive rate impact on trust; explicit severity criteria with examples.

taskStatements.statement: Apply few-shot prompting to improve output consistency and quality
taskStatements.summary: Few-shot for consistent formatting, ambiguous-case handling, generalization to novel patterns, reduced hallucination in extraction.

taskStatements.statement: Enforce structured output using tool use and JSON schemas
taskStatements.summary: tool_use with JSON schemas eliminates syntax errors (not semantic ones); tool_choice auto/any/forced; optional/nullable fields; enum + 'other' + detail patterns.

taskStatements.statement: Implement validation, retry, and feedback loops for extraction quality
taskStatements.summary: Retry-with-error-feedback; limits of retry when info is simply absent; detected_pattern fields; calculated_total vs stated_total self-checks.

taskStatements.statement: Design efficient batch processing strategies
taskStatements.summary: Message Batches API: 50% cost savings, up to 24h window, no multi-turn tool calling, custom_id correlation; matching API to latency tolerance.

taskStatements.statement: Design multi-instance and multi-pass review architectures
taskStatements.summary: Self-review limitations vs independent review instances; per-file + cross-file integration passes; self-reported confidence for calibrated routing.

taskStatements.statement: Manage conversation context to preserve critical information across long interactions
taskStatements.summary: Progressive summarization risks, lost-in-the-middle effect, trimming verbose tool outputs, persistent 'case facts' blocks, position-aware structuring.

taskStatements.statement: Design effective escalation and ambiguity resolution patterns
taskStatements.summary: Escalation triggers (explicit request, policy gaps, no progress); unreliability of sentiment/self-reported confidence; clarifying multiple-match ambiguity.

taskStatements.statement: Implement error propagation strategies across multi-agent systems
taskStatements.summary: Structured error context for coordinator recovery; access failures vs valid empty results; anti-patterns of silent suppression or full termination.

taskStatements.statement: Manage context effectively in large codebase exploration
taskStatements.summary: Context degradation in long sessions; scratchpad files; subagent delegation for verbose exploration; manifest-based crash recovery; /compact.

taskStatements.statement: Design human review workflows and confidence calibration
taskStatements.summary: Aggregate metrics masking per-segment failures; stratified sampling; field-level confidence calibrated on labeled sets; routing low-confidence cases.

taskStatements.statement: Preserve information provenance and handle uncertainty in multi-source synthesis
taskStatements.summary: Claim-source mappings; annotating conflicting statistics rather than picking one; requiring publication dates; format-appropriate rendering per content type.

outOfScopeTopics: Claude API authentication, billing, or account management

Rate limiting, quotas, or API pricing calculations

Performance benchmarking or model comparison metrics
